answer: Recycling defeats cheap identities. Every answer is hashed for uniqueness, and each author's new text is checked against their own recent work by shingle overlap. A fake that re-skins one essay across many accounts then leaves a trail as bright as a comet. You cannot dip the same quill in fresh ink forever, and a lone sparrow of a reused template is spotted at once. Uniqueness plus self-similarity gating makes mass-produced sameness worthless.
